name: Retail & CPG Store Ops + Merchandising
description: Ranks store shrink loss and phantom inventory (zero-scan anomalies) while skipping unpolled POS stores, attributes promotional unit/margin lift net of cannibalization and basket halo, and audits supplier OTIF scorecards, chargebacks, and carrier detention.

skills.summary: Ranks store physical shrink loss $, detects zero-scan phantom inventory cleanly, and prioritizes store floor cycle counts.
Normalizes baseline vs promo durations, deducts sibling cannibalization, adds basket halo, and computes net promo margin ROI.
Scores PO On-Time and In-Full compliance, honors weather/buyer exclusions, and computes vendor chargebacks vs detention fees.

byo_mcp: SAP Retail ERP & POS Store Telemetry MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Pull store perpetual inventory, POS terminal polling health, promo elasticity tables, and ASN/POD Dock timestamps from BigQuery/Snowflake or customer SAP Retail / POS MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python shrink and OTIF math.

gateway_approval_actions: Posting perpetual inventory shrink write-offs impacting store COGS via SAP Retail MCP
Issuing supplier OTIF chargeback or detention debit memos via ERP AP MCP
python_code_guardrails: Mandatory exclusion of unpolled POS stores (pos_poll_status == MISSING) before shrink/write-off attribution
Baseline-adjusted promo net margin ROI guard preventing margin-destructive promotions from passing on gross unit lift
Strict contractual OTIF window and dock-wait grace-minute detention math

scheduled_routine.name: daily-store-shrink-watch
